name: Tamsin
how: Joins on the greenling run in the prologue.
look: done

name: Sela
job: Kith pen hand, later a scout
how: Only if Corran paid for a second child in 'The carts'. Rhea frees her from a hatchery cart in Act I.
look: girl of eight, thin face, cropped dark hair growing out unevenly, large wary grey eyes, faded indenture number stitched on her collar, oversized brown wool coat, quiet and watchful

name: Ketti
how: The girl of twelve who walks out of the burning hatchery carrying two smaller children. Joins if Rhea lets her keep them.
look: girl of twelve, fierce narrow face, soot on her cheek, tangled auburn hair tied with twine, small fresh burn scar on her jaw, ragged hatchery smock under a too-big army jacket, defiant stare

name: Pell
job: Brood keeper in the greenling caves
how: Taken in the raid at eight. Found in House Corvel's hatchery as a teenager.
look: boy of fifteen, gangly, freckled, sandy hair cut short, raw red lull bite marks on his forearms, shy lopsided smile, patched grey hatchery tunic

name: Oda
job: Greenling tray keeper, knows the old strengths
how: Hid in the spring caves during the raid. Found at the ruins on the first harvest if Rhea searches the caves.
look: old woman of seventy, deeply lined warm brown face, white hair in a thick braid, one cloudy eye, moss-stained fingers, heavy knitted shawl, gentle sad smile

name: Posy
job: Scrapper with a brood hook, rallies the freed children
how: Freed with Corran from the brood rooms in Act III. Joins whatever Rhea does with Corran, but says what she thinks of it.
look: girl of fifteen, hard pale face, close-cropped black hair, dark circles under sharp green eyes, lull bite scars along her forearms, leather brood-room apron over a grey smock, unflinching expression

name: Brannoc
how: Rhea's sergeant from the day she enlists.
look: huge broad-shouldered man in his mid forties, gentle tired eyes, bald head, short greying beard, eleven small round pale scars climbing the side of his neck above an open collar, worn quilted army coat, soft-spoken calm

name: Marshal Idris Kane
how: Commands the army from Act I. Leaves in Act IV, by arrest or by his plan.
look: handsome man in his early fifties, charming confident half smile, silver-streaked dark hair swept back, neatly trimmed beard, keen hazel eyes, dark green officer's greatcoat with brass buttons and a red scarf

name: Dorrit Sayle
how: Joins when Rhea founds Thornwick, if its storeroom is rebuilt first.
look: brisk woman in her late thirties, round spectacles, ink-stained fingers, chestnut hair in a tight bun with a pencil through it, sleeves rolled up, canvas apron full of tally sticks, sceptical raised eyebrow

name: Ferris Lom
how: Found treed by his own reedcat during an Act I patrol. Joins if Rhea gets them both down.
look: lean wiry man in his late twenties, sun-browned skin, sly grin, messy black hair under a knitted cap, faint scar through one eyebrow, green hooded scout cloak with burrs stuck to it

name: Mags Orrel
how: Joins after the Brannoc's Kitchen contest, win or lose.
look: stout ruddy woman in her mid fifties, laugh lines, frizzy grey-red hair under a kerchief, flour on her cheek, burly forearms, big wooden spoon over her shoulder, mischievous grin

name: Captain Bryn Hallet
how: Kane's loyalist. Stays with Rhea when Kane is arrested, only if Rhea shut the lull trade herself.
look: stern weathered man in his early forties, square jaw, short-cropped grey hair, burn scar down one cheek, hard pale blue eyes, dented steel gorget over a dark green army coat

name: Merel Asca
job: Breeder, knows the second breeding line
how: Only if Rhea refuses Mother Asca's private supply. Asca's granddaughter comes over after the old woman's House falls.
look: elegant young woman in her mid twenties, pale skin, ash-blonde hair in a precise braided crown, grey eyes red-rimmed from grief, high-collared black Guild breeder's coat with silver House Mire embroidery, composed and guarded

name: Fennick
job: Spy in the Guild counting houses
how: The House Mire clerk who smuggles Rhea the ledger page. Joins if she gets him out before the House finds him.
look: nervous thin man in his early thirties, receding mouse-brown hair, wire spectacles, ink on his lips from chewing pens, high stiff clerk's collar, dark grey waistcoat, anxious darting eyes

name: King Aldous
how: Only if Rhea exposes the queen mother. A free king rides out with his guard for the last campaign.
look: slender young man of nineteen, pale and tired, soft wavy auburn hair, earnest dark eyes older than his face, thin gold circlet, plain dark hunting coat with the crown's stag badge

name: Tess
job: Song leader, raises the army's morale
how: Only if the Coldharrow strike wins.
look: young woman of nineteen, sharp cheekbones, lively brown eyes, curly dark hair tied up in a mill scarf, left hand bandaged with three fingers missing, one pale lull ring scar at her collar, grey mill dress with a red armband

name: Joss Kettering
how: Joins whichever way the strike ends, but on the broker path only if Rhea returns before the Act IV riots.
look: rangy man in his mid forties, hollow cheeks, deep-set fierce eyes, black hair going grey at the temples, two days of stubble, loom-worker's leather cuffs, rough brown coat, fiery speaker's expression

name: Oren Tull
how: Only if Rhea stands beside him when he names Larkfold.
look: heavy-set grieving man near fifty, stone dust in his greying beard, kind red-rimmed eyes, mourning ribbon pinned to his work coat, big scarred mason's hands

name: Grandmother Ume
how: Joins when Rhea breaks the clans' debts to the Guild.
look: tiny very old woman of eighty-four, dark weathered face like walnut, bright amused black eyes, long white hair wound with moss-green cords, woven shawl patterned with terraces, carved walking staff

name: Teo
how: Joins whether Rhea turns him in or hides him, but only joins the party if hidden. Turned in, he serves at Thornwick after clan law.
look: young man of twenty, brown skin, guilty restless eyes, long black hair tied back, climbing ropes coiled over one shoulder, moss-stained clan tunic with woven bands

name: Ilse Varn
how: Joins when Rhea protects her and opens the ledgers.
look: poised woman in her mid thirties, dark skin, close-cropped black hair, gold hoop earrings, calculating amber eyes, crisp navy banker's jacket with a high white collar

name: Perrine
how: Only if Rhea loses the Hollin vote honestly.
look: striking woman in her mid thirties, olive skin, dark wavy hair pinned up, intelligent sorrowful brown eyes, faint pale lull ring scars above her collar, deep red debater's coat with a mourning pin

name: Professor Haldane
job: Runs the greenling trials at Thornwick
how: Joins when the College's open trial begins.
look: stooped old man in his late sixties, untidy white hair, bushy eyebrows, half-moon spectacles, sharp blue eyes, black physician's robe with a frayed College sash

name: Gerd
how: Joins after the duel, if Rhea beats him without shaming his son.
look: massive weathered man near fifty, braided iron-grey beard, shaved head with clan tattoos, a fresh bandage across his brow, fur-trimmed scale armour, proud wounded eyes

name: Arvo
how: Only if Rhea beats Gerd quietly. Arvo owes her his name and asks to be weaned.
look: boy of sixteen, pale, sullen and ashamed, shaggy light-brown hair, high fur collar hiding his neck, clan tattoo on one cheekbone, scale vest too big for him

name: Prince Rashid
how: Only if Rhea backs Rashid's coup.
look: intense man in his late twenties, warm bronze skin, short black curls, close beard, earnest burning dark eyes, layered sand-coloured robes with a sun-embroidered sash

name: Prince Khalis
job: Desert guard and the southern road
how: Only if Rhea wins Khalis over instead of backing his brother.
look: composed man in his late thirties, bronze skin, oiled black hair, thin moustache, heavy-lidded shrewd eyes, rich crimson and gold court robes, ringed hands

name: Nadra
how: A retired palace guard's daughter met in the Prince's Garden. Joins on either Ember Courts path.
look: young woman in her early twenties, sun-dark skin, kohl-lined bright eyes, long black hair under a light sand-coloured headscarf, leather falconer's glove, mistwing feather earring

name: Vela Orme
how: Joins with her company when Rhea outbids the Guild.
look: tough woman in her early forties, tanned and weathered, cropped white-blonde hair, scar splitting her upper lip, cool appraising grey eyes, battered black leather and mail, a coin on a cord round her neck

name: Kesh
how: Only if Tarsis is paid in greenlings and coin. One of the company who goes through the raw and stays.
look: lithe man around thirty, dark brown skin, shaven head, hollow cheeks from the raw, wry tired smile, pale lull ring scars on his neck, sleeveless studded leather jerkin

name: Gully Sorne
job: Harbourmaster, runs the tunnels and boats
how: Only if Rhea promises Ashby its routes.
look: wiry man in his late thirties, weathered tan face, crooked nose, gold tooth in a sly grin, faded hatchery number tattooed on his wrist, salt-stained sea coat with brass buttons, tricorn-like felt hat

name: Captain Rue Halsey
job: Smuggler captain, river and sea fleet
how: Joins after the Lantern Cards final, or if Ashby joins Rhea.
look: confident woman in her mid forties, sun-creased face, wild silver-streaked black hair under a red scarf, eyepatch, many earrings, long blue captain's coat

name: Magistrate Aurel Penn
how: Brannoc's brother-in-law. Joins if Brannoc's trial is won.
look: austere man around fifty, thin face, neat grey side-whiskers, severe but conflicted eyes, black magistrate's robe with a white rope-knot collar badge

name: Isel
how: Joins when Rhea answers the elders about Dellan, whatever she tells them.
look: ethereal woman in her early thirties, light brown skin, very long white-dyed hair blowing loose, silver-crested mistwing feathers woven in, pale grey eyes, layered sky-blue wind cloak

name: Dellan
how: Only if Rhea tells her the truth. She comes, with her family, and remembers one song.
look: capable woman in her late twenties, light brown skin, short practical white-blonde hair, faint Spire Folk tattoo dots under one eye, Guild breeder's apron over a plain dress, troubled searching eyes

name: Sister Agathe
how: Joins if Rhea brings the Sisters greenlings and Agathe breaks with her abbess.
look: serene woman about forty, pale candlelit face, shaved head, calm grey eyes, faint rope burns on her wrists, plain undyed grey habit with a water-drop pendant

name: Harl
how: Joins when Osk is saved, on either path.
look: broad weathered man near sixty, ruddy face, white seaman's beard, laughing blue eyes, collar deliberately open showing a full neck of old pale lull ring scars, oilskin coat

name: Ysolde Salter
job: Archivist, keeps the Salt House records
how: Joins on either choice, but publishes the records only if asked.
look: dignified woman in her mid forties, salt-weathered fair skin, long dark hair with a white streak in a loose braid, steady hazel eyes, faded old Guild house coat with the crest cut away, salt crusted at the hems

name: Tavi
job: Nomad rider, bonded to the herd matriarch
how: Only if Rhea stops her own side's poachers.
look: young nomad of twenty-two, dark bronze skin, wind-burned cheeks, long black braids with bone beads, calm level dark eyes, felt and leather riding coat with ironback-hide shoulder guards

name: Hesk Marrow
job: Kith master, runs the breeding wing
how: Finds Rhea singing to Ash at the kith pen.
look: grizzled man in his early sixties, weather-beaten face, white stubble, haunted kind brown eyes, flat cap, patched waxed coat, loftbuck hair on his sleeves

name: Pim Calloway
how: Only if Rhea refuses to sell her lines and still wins the great drove. Pim comes over, cheerfully, to the winner.
look: dapper man in his mid thirties, bright cheerful grin, perfectly combed golden hair, waxed moustache, too-clever blue eyes, peacock-teal show jacket with rosettes pinned to it

name: Sergeant Oakes
how: Only if Rhea spares the captured Wardens.
look: solid man in his mid thirties, plain honest face, close-cropped brown hair, ashamed downcast eyes, grey Warden coat with the badge torn off, bandaged knuckles

name: Lyle
how: Spared with Oakes. Joins later, after he hears Finch is alive.
look: young man of twenty-four, pale freckled skin, unruly copper hair, nervous quick green eyes, grey Warden archer's hood pushed back, bowstring calluses

name: Old Grue
how: The toll bridge riddler. Joins after Rhea tells him a riddle he hasn't heard.
look: gleeful wizened old man of eighty, bald spotted head, enormous white eyebrows, twinkling small eyes, toothy grin, moth-eaten toll keeper's coat with keys on a chain

name: Mirela Quell
job: Stargazer, forecasts weather for army battles
how: Joins after the Cloud Sea Stargazer nights.
look: gentle old woman near seventy, silver hair loose and wind-blown, star-chart ink on her fingers, bright curious eyes behind brass-rimmed lenses, indigo shawl embroidered with constellations

name: Lom Fairweather
how: The honest smuggler. Joins when Rhea returns his ledger unread.
look: cheerful plump man around sixty, rosy cheeks, bushy white sideburns, twinkling eyes, battered bowler-style felt hat, waistcoat with many pockets

name: Teodric Vane
how: Joins after the Play About Rhea opens.
look: theatrical man in his early thirties, pale, dramatic sweep of black hair, thin pointed beard, expressive dark eyes, velvet plum coat with a quill behind his ear

name: Bee
how: The child writing letters to the moon. Joins after the Mistwing Post.
look: cheerful girl of ten, brown skin, gap-toothed grin, two puffy dark pigtails, satchel of letters, oversized flight goggles pushed up on her forehead, patched blue jacket

name: Sly Annet
job: Card sharp, runs the Lantern Cards table
how: The last Lantern Cards champion before Osk's chart. Joins if Rhea beats her fairly.
look: sharp-featured woman in her late twenties, sly half smile, short black bob with a streak of blue, a card tucked behind her ear, dark eyeliner, tavern waistcoat over a loose white shirt

name: Widow Hobb
job: Loftbuck driver, runs the pack trains
how: Joins with the swearing loftbuck after Rhea learns its words.
look: wiry old woman in her mid sixties, wind-reddened face, salty grin, short grey hair under a felt hat, pipe stem in her teeth, sheepskin vest, mourning band on her arm

name: Dr Lisle
how: Only if the College finds the Guild's old trial and Rhea offers him a way out.
look: done

name: Finch
how: Joins for the finale if his trust in Rhea is high.
look: done

name: Corran
how: Joins for the last gate only if he is clean and spared.
look: done
